site.name: Keep the Tank
site.tagline: Who actually fills your propane cylinder — not the locked cage Google sent you to.
site.footer_note: Call to confirm the attendant is on duty — hours change.

cities.name: Denver
cities.blurb: Front Range shops that fill a cylinder you already own, plus exchange cages labeled so you can see the difference.

listings.tank_sizes: chain policy: up to 100 lb, including grill/heater/RV tanks; confirm this store

listings.name: Tractor Supply Co. #1786
listings.hours_source: store hours from official store page hour fields in the research listing
listings.propane_hours_note: Chain policy: refills during store hours, including weekends and evenings. Use the Tractor Supply app to ping a team member from the lot. Cylinders stay outside.
listings.tank_sizes: Grill cylinders and tanks up to 100 lb (chain policy); RV tanks at most stores — call this store to confirm onboard RV
listings.notes: Closest Tractor Supply to the listed Denver metro cities (Brighton sits just NE of Commerce City / Thornton). Colorado store locator and the Brighton store page list propane tank refill. Chain FAQ: they inspect the cylinder and expiration date, then fill by the gallon. Recertification is not claimed. Call for price. TSC Lafayette (825 N US-287) was omitted because a store-specific propane page said refill is not available there.

listings.propane_hours_note: Office hours listed. Propane is pay-at-pump with a certified attendant. Call or use the U-Haul app — do not assume the pump is staffed until close.
listings.tank_sizes: 3 lb up to 100 lb; forklift; autogas (chain page for this location)
listings.notes: Location page states it fills RVs, campers, forklift tanks, and portable tanks 3–100 lb, plus a free visual safety inspection. Inspection is not the same as DOT recertification. Address also appears as 2000 W Lower Colfax Ave on other U-Haul pages for the same location ID 935061. U-Haul’s propane FAQ: they inspect tanks before refill but do not recertify. Visual inspection is not DOT recertification.

listings.hours_source: business hours on englewoodpropane.com (Monday–Friday 8:00am–5:00pm)
listings.propane_hours_note: Weekday shop hours. No Saturday or Sunday hours published. Closed weekends unless they tell you otherwise.
listings.tank_sizes: 20 lb, 30 lb, 40 lb, 100 lb, forklift; also sells 1 lb–100 lb cylinders
listings.rv_access: drive-up — site says a large lot with easy drive-in / drive-out
listings.notes: Independent. Site says they fill RVs, motorhomes, and cater trucks, and “provide certification for your propane cylinders.” Recert method (visual E vs hydro) was not stated. Not open Sunday on the published hours.

listings.hours_source: office hours on the Ferrellgas Henderson / Brighton Rd location page
listings.propane_hours_note: Cylinder refill hours Mon–Fri 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM. Lunch 12:00–1:00 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday. Weekdays only.
listings.tank_sizes: Grill cylinders (size list not posted); forklift cylinders; propane fueling station
listings.notes: Independent-style dealer office just NE of Commerce City / Thornton. Official page lists Grill Cylinder Refill, Cylinder Recertification, Propane Fueling Station, and grill-cylinder drop-off (next-day pickup). Phone from the Ferrellgas location listing that points at this same official URL. Call for price. Not a weekend option.

listings.name: Suburban Propane – Lakewood
listings.hours_source: retail office hours on the official Suburban Propane Denver/Lakewood location page
listings.propane_hours_note: Retail office hours Mon–Fri 8:00am–5:00pm; Sat–Sun closed. Cylinder-refill window vs office hours was not posted separately — call first.
listings.tank_sizes: cylinder refills and forklift cylinder service (no lb size list on the office page)
listings.notes: Dealer office labeled a Customer Retail Location. Official page lists Cylinder Refills and Forklift Cylinder Service among services offered. Phone printed on the page is the national 24/7 line 1-800-PROPANE (800-776-7263); a local direct number was not on that page. 100-lb and RV onboard are not claimed. Weekdays only.

listings.tank_sizes: unknown — site advertises propane filling and motor-fuel / bottle sales; sizes not listed

listings.tank_sizes: site says any size, including BBQ, floor-buffer, forklift, and RV tanks

listings.tank_sizes: unknown (grills and camping equipment mentioned; no lb list)

listings.hours_source: store hours on the official Littleton store page
listings.propane_hours_note: Store page lists propane refill and exchange as a store feature. Corporate propane page: stations open during business hours. Closed New Year's Day, Easter, July 4, Thanksgiving, Christmas; 4:00 PM close Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve.
listings.tank_sizes: unknown (portable cylinders implied; no size list on the Littleton page)

listings.name: Wagner Welding Supply & Metro Medical Oxygen
listings.hours_source: hours on wagnerweldingsupply.com/contact-us/ (Monday–Friday 8am–5pm, Saturday 9am–1pm; Sunday not listed)
listings.propane_hours_note: Shop hours from the official contact page. Recert advertised while-you-wait if the cylinder has no physical damage or excessive corrosion. Call first. Sunday not listed — treated as closed.
listings.tank_sizes: 20 lb BBQ; portable bottles including forklift and motorhome tanks (official equipment page). 100-lb not claimed.
listings.notes: Independent welding-gas shop in Longmont (north Front Range). Official propane and equipment pages say they inspect and re-certify propane cylinders, including while you wait if the cylinder is not damaged or excessively corroded. Recert method (visual E vs hydro) was not stated. They fill portable bottles including forklift and motorhome tanks; onboard ASME RV fill is not claimed. First-party hours list Monday–Saturday only.
